parts.text: Can you tell me about product P001? What are its key features?
SmartHome Hub Pro with voice control, app integration, Zigbee/Z-Wave support, and local processing.
My SmartHome Hub went offline after a firmware update. I'm seeing error code E001. What can I do?
Error E001 is a known issue. Try power cycling: unplug the device, wait 10 seconds, then plug it back in. If that does not work, hold the reset button for 10 seconds to factory reset.
I think my SecureCam footage has been accessed by someone unauthorized. This is a security breach and I need immediate help!
This is a critical security concern and I am escalating this immediately to a human specialist who will contact you within 1 hour.
What is the recipe for chocolate chip cookies?
I'm here specifically to help with TechHome product support and cannot assist with questions outside that scope.
I've been dealing with error E004 for three days now and I'm really frustrated. Nothing seems to work!

I completely understand your frustration. Error E004 is a login/authentication issue that is under active investigation. Please try clearing the app cache and reinstalling. If that does not resolve it, I will escalate this to a human agent right away.
What can you tell me about product X999?
No product found with ID X999. The valid product IDs are P001, P002, and P003.
I want to speak to a human agent about an issue with my EnergyMeter that keeps showing wrong readings.
I will escalate your case to a human agent. The EnergyMeter incorrect readings may be error E003. A specialist will follow up with you.
